punchline: In Singer's picture a sore spot is a splinter that hurts only when touched, so you can spend your life avoiding it or pull it out.
thirty_sec: Michael Singer says energy gets blocked when you close up or cling, and a summary adds that blocked energy cannot reach the heart. His image is a splinter that hurts when touched: you can arrange your whole life so nothing bumps it, or you can pull it out. The practice he describes is to stay open and let the feeling pass through. It is a spiritual teaching, so try it small.
